meals.title: Braai Pork Chops with Butternut and Cucumber-Yoghurt Salad
meals.why: Pork braai chops are R69.99/kg, the cheapest braai meat on special this week, and butternut is only R14.99/kg.
method: Rub the chops with oil, garlic, braai spice, salt and pepper. Leave them for 15 minutes or marinate in the fridge all day.
Cut the butternut into thick wedges, skin on. Toss with oil and salt, wrap in foil and put on the coals for 25-30 minutes until soft.
Braai the chops over medium coals for 5-7 minutes per side until cooked through with crisp fat.
Dice the cucumber and stir into the yoghurt with garlic, lemon juice, salt and herbs.
Serve the chops with the butternut and the cool cucumber-yoghurt on the side.

meals.title: Butternut and Mixed Veg Curry with Parboiled Rice
meals.why: Cheap butternut, frozen veg, tinned tomatoes and a 2kg bag of rice make a filling vegetarian dinner for well under R20 a head.
method: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in oil until soft. Add the curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tinned tomatoes and about 1 cup of water. Add the butternut in 2cm cubes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the frozen mixed veg and cook for another 8-10 minutes until the butternut is tender. Season with salt.
Cook the rice in salted water for about 20-25 minutes, then drain.
Serve the curry over the rice with a spoon of yoghurt on top.

meals.title: One-Pot Mince and Macaroni
meals.why: Lean beef mince is R109.99/kg (R99.99 with a Checkers loyalty card), and a small amount stretched with macaroni and tomatoes feeds the whole family fast.
method: Brown 500g of mince with the chopped onion and garlic in a large pot, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato paste and grated carrot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tinned tomatoes, 2 cups of water, the stock cube and herbs, then bring to a boil.
Stir in the macaroni, cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season and serve straight from the pot.

meals.title: Slow-Cooked Beef Potjiekos with Potatoes and Carrots
meals.why: PnP Beef Potjiekos is R99.99/kg, and with potatoes and carrots also on special, one pot feeds the family with leftovers for lunch.
also_need: splash of red wine or vinegar (optional)
method: Brown the potjiekos in batches in a heavy pot or cast-iron potjie with oil, then set aside.
Fry the sliced onions and garlic, stir in the tomato paste, then return the meat to the pot.
Add the stock cube dissolved in 2 cups of hot water, the bay leaves and the wine or vinegar. Cover and simmer on low (or in a 160°C oven) for 1.5 hours.
Add the chunked carrots and halved potatoes and cook for another 40-45 minutes without stirring too much.
Season, rest for 10 minutes and serve.

meals.title: Cheesy Tuna Pasta Bake
meals.why: Shredded tuna at R25 and a big block of Gouda make a cheap oven bake that comes mostly out of the cupboard.

uses.item: Shredded tuna in oil or brine

method: Cook the pasta in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain. Heat the oven to 190°C.
Make a cheese sauce: melt the butter, stir in 3 Tbsp flour, whisk in 2 cups of milk and cook until thick. Stir in most of the grated Gouda, plus salt, pepper and mustard.
Fry the onion and garlic, add the tinned tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the tuna.
Combine the pasta, tuna-tomato mix and cheese sauce in an ovenproof dish and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

meals.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken with Butternut and Carrots
meals.why: The SPAR 4kg frozen chicken pack works out cheap per portion, and butternut and carrots make it a one-tray dinner.

uses.item: SPAR Frozen Chicken Mixed Portions with a Brine Based Mixture (4kg)

also_need: salt (go easy, the chicken is brined)
method: Thaw the chicken portions in the fridge overnight. Pat dry and heat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the butternut into chunks and the carrots into sticks, and spread them on a large baking tray.
Toss the chicken with oil, paprika, garlic powder, herbs and pepper, then nestle it among the veg.
Roast for 45-55 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Mix some yoghurt with lemon juice and herbs as a cooling sauce, and serve it with the chicken and veg.
